content.text:
I fixed the dropdown getting stuck on "Current" when the `current` version's path is `/`. The existing client tests pass (44/44). I didn't add a test for this exact setup or check it in a running site.

**Cause:** The code that works out which version a page belongs to (`getActiveVersion` in `packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts`) checked every version's path in turn and kept the first match. It only made sure the *latest released* version was checked last. With `current` set to `/`, its path is `/docs/`, which also matches `/docs/v0.1.2/...`. Since `current` isn't the latest released version, it was checked early and claimed every page. That's why the dropdown never changed label.

**Fix:** Versions are now sorted before matching, so a path that contains another version's path is checked first. For example, `/docs/v0.1.2/` is now checked before `/docs/`, so a catch-all path like `/docs/` only wins when nothing more specific matches. This replaces the old "move the latest version to the end" rule, which only worked when the latest version happened to be the catch-all.
